method: Only complete native stdout/stderr files were read; all hashes/identities/bytes/oracles were verified.
Raw samples independently select sorted index nearest p*(N-1), half upwards, then normalize by operation count.
Eight matched helper/manual pairs per group; median ratios are not ratios of independent medians.
All 48 metrics, 96 pairs, AB/BA, first/last halves and undefined zero-baseline ratios are retained.
Count configuration is observed from native create forwarders; raw configuration is only an expected contract label.
Both methods use the same timing executable and loaded core bytes; installed headers and package files are frozen.
limits: No previous 832-process core optimization data was pooled or inherited.
This audit never builds or runs native/target executables, invokes devices or samples timings.
Counts cover successful C++ new requests in executable binding scope, not all DLL/OS heap or failed new-handler attempts.
Fresh-domain cold cases have four warmup rounds; they are not cold process/OS startup.
Wall excludes command parsing/result-vector allocation/reporting, but includes domain create, owner/lease cleanup and final RAII domain destroy.
Five-percent candidates are descriptive flags requiring at least six unfavorable pairs and both halves/order strata above one; not statistical qualification or causal proof.
CPU frequency, affinity, other activity and scheduling remain uncontrolled.
